source: Collaboration messages from /root/ii_check_a, received after both new releases.
formal_functions_input: A described the coherent F/m_s^k F, finite nilradical filtration, point torsion, finite normalization/vector-bundle and length-one Dolbeault argument, followed by Grauert1960 Section6 HauptsatzIIa p59, coherence and Nakayama, with the1963 corrigendum. The receiver then opened those primary loci and verified every step.

cyclic_quotient_input.tacnode: The two normalized P1 components have equal t parameter and local subring f=g mod t^2; their swap gives the global cubic involution, locally (x,y)->(x,x^2-y).
cyclic_quotient_input.base: Eprime=C/(Z+iZ); translation tau_r by1/r; diagonal quotient (C_r x Eprime)/<(sigma_r,tau_r)> forr2,3.
cyclic_quotient_input.normalization: Choose one normalized component; its product with Eprime is isomorphic to the normalized quotient. The conductor is twice the single Eprime section and maps by the exact degree-r unramified cover to E.
cyclic_quotient_input.locality_clarification: After restore_build raised the nontrivial action on nilpotent directions, A confirmed that O_E[u]/u^2 and O_E[u,v]/(u,v)^2 describe analytic local algebras only, with no global untwisted-algebra assertion.

receiver_independent_verification: Explicit parameter maps, the normalized-quotient inverse and all local-ring/conductor relations are written in the complete proposed proof and comparison. Postrelease exact identities are separately executed.
